working_definition: Author cell type 'cell body glial cell' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00001297 'cell body glial cell', in the body analysis (whole fly minus head; 775 cells). Cell body glia are part of the CNS cell body rind, and the only CNS in the body is the ventral nerve cord.
